entities.summary: Sabah al-Salem Stadium is a multi-purpose stadium in Kuwait City, Kuwait. It is currently used mostly for football matches and is the home stadium of Al Arabi Kuwait. The stadium holds 26,000 people and had hosted many matches of the 1980 AFC Asian Cup, including the final.
